#----------------------------------------------------------
test set id "isDateTimeFormat"

${i} = 0
LOOP (${i} < $TEST_DATA.length) (
  ${in} = $TEST_DATA[${i}].in
  %{in}
  ${ret} = %{in}
  test verify -label "%{in}" ${ret} == $TEST_DATA[${i}].out
  ${i}++
)

test end
test result
